definition: Handling, collecting, storing and disposing of materials that pose substantial threats to public or personal health or the environment.

en:
Hazardous waste is defined in accordance with the latest EU guidance on the classification of waste: https://europa.eu/!kr89QF Examples:
- Dispose of medical waste - Handle chemical cleaning agents.

label: disposing of non-hazardous waste or debris
label_nl: verwijderen van niet-gevaarlijke afval en puin
definition: Collecting and disposing of unwanted non-hazardous materials according to established waste management procedures.

en:
Examples:
- Handle fish harvesting waste - Collect domestic waste.

label: moving and lifting
definition: Performing physical activities to move, load, unload or store objects, position workpieces or equipment for assembly, or to climb structures, by hand or with the aid of equipment.

en:
Excludes:
- Specific skills involving lifting and moving people and animals
- Operation of machinery other than hand-held equipment.

label: loading and unloading goods and, materials
label_nl: laden en lossen van goederen en materialen
definition: Loading, securing or unloading products, materials, or equipment for transportation, storage or further processing by hand or using hand-held or manually operated equipment.

en:

- Unload supplies.

label: moving or lifting materials, equipment, or supplies
label_nl: verplaatsen of optillen van materialen, apparatuur en voorraden
definition: Moving or lifting goods, materials supplies or resources, by hand or with the aid of equipment, using actions such as lifting, pushing, carrying or shovelling.

en:
Excludes:
- Operation of machinery other than hand-held equipment Examples:
- Feed concrete mixer
- Transfer luggage
- Lift heavy weights.

label: storing goods and materials
definition: Placing goods and materials in storage by hand, or with the aid of hand-held or manually operated equipment.

en:
Excludes:
- Operation of machinery other than hand-held equipment - Storing hazardous material Examples:
- Stock shelves
- Store film reels.

label: positioning materials, tools or equipment
definition: Placing workpieces, materials, tools or equipment in the correct position for assembly or further work.

en:

- Operation of machinery other than hand-held equipment Examples:

label: transforming and blending materials
definition: Transforming materials from one form to another by mixing, blending, heating or chemical reaction, by hand or using handheld tools and equipment.

label: transforming and blending materials
definition: Transforming materials from one form to another by mixing, blending, heating or chemical reaction, by hand or using handheld tools and equipment.

label: preparing mixtures or solutions
definition: Mixing and blending various types of solid or liquid materials, by hand or using handheld tools and equipment.

en:
Examples:
- Mix paint
- Mix construction grouts
- Blend food ingredients.

label: preparing industrial materials for processing or use
label_nl: voorbereiden van industriële materialen voor verwerking of gebruik
definition: Preparing various types of materials for further processing or for use, by employing techniques such as heating, skimming to remove impurities or immersing objects in cleaning or coating solutions.

en:
Examples:
- Heat jewellery metals
- Heat lacquer mixture
- Prepare surface for coating.

label: collecting and preparing specimens or materials for testing
label_nl: verzamelen en voorbereiden van monsters en materialen voor testen
definition: Taking, preparing or preserving as required samples or specimens of products, liquids chemicals or organic materials in order for them to be ready for testing and analysis.

en:
Examples:
- Prepare chemical samples
- Collect samples for analysis.

label: cultivating land and crops

en:

- Irrigate soil

label: planting, pruning and harvesting trees, crops and other plants
label_nl: planten van landbouwgewassen, bomen en andere planten
definition: Propagating and planting trees, flowers and other plants for production of food crops and other products, enhancing the environment or for scientific research.

en:
Examples:
- Seed the ground
- Propagate plants - Plant trees.

label: pruning, cutting and harvesting, trees crops and other plants
label_nl: snoeien, knippen en oogsten van bomen, gewassen en andere planten
definition: Reducing the size, removing limbs, or cutting down trees, shrubs and other crops, by hand or with hand-held tools for purposes such as improving appearance, promoting the growth of fruits, and harvesting.

en:

- Prune vines
- De-limb trees
- Harvest grapes.

label: assembling and fabricating products
definition: Fabricating, assembling or repairing products or work aids by hand, or using hand-held tools and equipment.

en:

- Assemble metal parts - Apply assembly techniques.

label: assembling and fabricating products

label: fabricating precision instruments or jewellery

en:
Excludes:
- Operation of automated assembly equipment
- Assembly of electrical and electronic products and components
- Fabrication of decorative objects - Fabrication of medical, orthotic and prosthetic devices Examples:
- Assemble jewellery parts
- Attach pendulums
- Customise guns
- Repair musical instruments
- Centre lenses.

label: fabricating medical and prosthetic devices
label_nl: vervaardigen van medische apparaten en prothesen
definition: Fabricating, maintaining or repairing medical, dental, orthotic or prosthetic devices.

en:
Excludes:
- Operation of automated assembly equipment or machines
- Fabricating or repairing optical devices Examples:
- Manufacture dental prostheses
- Create lifecasts
- Repair orthopaedic goods.

label: assembling electrical and electronic products
label_nl: monteren van elektrische en elektronische producten
definition: Assembling electrical and electronic products, excluding medical or prosthetic devices, by hand or using hand-held tools and equipment.

en:
Excludes:
- Operation of automated assembly equipment
- Installation, repair and maintenance of devices
- Fabrication of decorative objects - Fabrication of medical, orthotic and prosthetic devices Examples:
- Assemble mechatronic devices
- Assemble electrical components.

label: assembling mechanical products
definition: Assembling mechanical products by hand or using hand-held tools and equipment.

en:

- Operation of automated assembly equipment
- Installation, repair and maintenance of machinery
- Fabrication of decorative objects - Fabrication of medical, orthotic and prosthetic devices Examples:
- Assemble bicycles
- Assemble machines.

label: assembling furniture
definition: Assembling and repairing furniture by hand or using hand-held tools and equipment.

en:

- Operation of automated assembly equipment

- Assemble prefabricated furniture
- Repair furniture frames.

label: fabricating garments and textile products
definition: Fabricating, altering and repairing garments and textile products by hand or using hand-held tools and equipment.

en:
Excludes:
- Operation of automated assembly equipment
- Fabrication of decorative objects Examples:
- Alter wearing apparel
- Manufacture male suits
- Repair shoes

label: fabricating food and related products
label_nl: produceren van voedsel en verwante producten
definition: Fabricating food, drink and related products by hand or using hand-held tools and equipment.

en:

- Preparing and cooking food and drinks for immediate consumption Examples:

label: fabricating tobacco products
definition: Fabricating tobacco products by hand or using hand-held tools and equipment.

en:

label: making models
